The company is currently failing to generate returns for shareholders, evidenced by a negative ROE of -0.68% compared to a sector benchmark of 4.67% [E8] and a complete lack of dividend payments [E3]. Long-term stagnation is evident in the 10-year compounded sales growth of -3% and the 3-year growth of 0% [E13, E15], suggesting that recent volatility in sales figures may not represent a sustainable trend. Furthermore, the scanX signal engine indicates that price growth is currently outpacing profit growth by 243%, signaling that market expectations have decoupled from actual delivery [E49].
